title: Notification Groups — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Groups linked to a notification configuration. Not used at present: sending notifications to groups was not carried over into HCMv3.

fields.label: NotificationConfig
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Notification Config master data.
fields.html: What it is. The notification configuration the group belongs to.

fields.label: NotifyRoleHolders
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Workflow Role master data.
fields.html:
What it is. A role whose current holders are notified, on top of whoever the configuration already addresses.

Why it matters. It follows the role, not a list of names: somebody who takes the role over starts receiving these notifications, and somebody whose assignment has ended stops. Holders are resolved the same way approvers are, so the people told about a step are the people who can act on it.

fields.label: NarrowToRequesterOrgScope
fields.rules: One of: none, company, department, branch, cost centre.
fields.html:
What it is. Limits the role holders to those in the requester's own part of the organisation.

Why it matters. Without it, a request from one department notifies that role everywhere in the company. Company narrows nothing, because a company is already a separate tenant here. If the narrowing leaves nobody, the wider group is notified rather than nobody at all.
